hook: AI gave me a 47-step plan when I asked how to fix my morning routine.
caption:
AI gave me a 47-step plan when I asked how to fix my morning routine.

I asked for help. Not a project proposal.

Here's the thing nobody talks about: AI doesn't know if you're a "just tell me the next move" person or a "give me the full framework so I can understand the system" person.

So it guesses. And it usually guesses wrong.

The Decisive Executor type? They want one action, a reason it works, and nothing else. They're already gone by bullet point three.

The Systems Architect type? They actually WANT the 47 steps — plus the underlying logic, the edge cases, and probably a diagram.

Same question. Completely different useful answers.

Right now your AI is flipping a coin every single time you open a chat. Sometimes it lands right. Most of the time you're rewording your prompt for the fourth time trying to get something that actually fits how your brain works.

BootFile builds a profile of how YOU think — your pace, your depth preference, your decision style — and gives AI the context to stop guessing.

No more 47-step morning routines when you needed one thing to try tomorrow.
